related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.campaign_objective: Make environmental services accountable through evidence from real MNCS development, and make machine-native work easier to discover and carry out.

measurement_basis: One live environmental-capability projection from this session omitted the capability-delivery section under response compaction. A refreshed session context separately reported the binding availability totals below. The baseline projection identity was not retained, so recurrence and agent impact are not established.
not_measured: whether an agent needed or attempted to use any binding in the snapshot
whether the omitted section caused manual intervention or changed an outcome
whether the condition recurs across sessions or other projection budgets
whether unknown or unavailable bindings are defective or native migration opportunities
whether an agent received, discovered, understood, or successfully used the capabilities

outcome.interpretation_limit: The binding totals came from the refreshed session context, not from the compact baseline projection. Their absence in one ECI response is an observability gap; it does not establish that all 37 non-available bindings were needed or caused agent work.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Response-budget compaction can hide current capability availability from ECI readers
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Retain a bounded provider-level availability summary and declaration source context in the evidence-priority response while preserving uncertainty about need, receipt, and usability.
